evals.name: paid-landing-url-french
evals.prompt: my google ads landing page just isn't converting and i can't tell where the drop-off is. can you audit it and tell me the one thing to fix first before i touch anything? it's https://info.planity.com/ — it's in french, for salon and barbershop owners.
evals.expected_output: A page audit: an overall score plus the six-category scorecard at the top, then a priority-ordered list of section-tagged opportunities (at most two or three HIGHs), a page-level and a sector-specific note, and a single start-here section. No copy rewrites. An audit.json + report.md handoff written under .webanatomy/audit-page/. Ends by handing off to write-page.

assertions.text: Writes an audit.json under .webanatomy/audit-page/ that parses as valid JSON
audit.json schema field equals 'webanatomy.audit-page.v1'

audit.json has a score.overall between 0 and 100, a score.band [lo,hi], and score.categoryScores covering all six categories (Hero, Value Proposition, Copywriting, Trust & Credibility, Conversion, Design & UX)

Writes a scorecard.json with all 49 rubric items, each having a status (pass|fail|n/a) and, for pass/fail items, an evidence_source (dom|render|text|inferred); score.overall in audit.json matches what score.mjs computes from it
Recommendations contain at most three items at severity HIGH
startHere is non-empty and equals the section of one of the recommendations
Every recommendation is tagged with a section, a severity label, and a copy/design kind
Output exposes no internal rubric item ids (no dotted tokens like hero.outcome_focus or conversion.cta_repetition) and no raw weights or thresholds
Output contains no paste-ready copy or headline rewrites (diagnosis only)
Output ends by offering the two grounded next steps (find-examples for the market view and write-page for the section rework) and names the start-here section

evals.name: codebase-homepage-no-render
evals.prompt: Before I start improving it, audit the marketing homepage in this repo and tell me which sections to revamp first. The page component is at app/(marketing)/page.tsx. Don't rewrite any copy yet, I just want direction and the order to work in.
evals.expected_output: A section-by-section audit driven from the page source. Because there may be no live render, the visual (V) items are marked Not-evaluable and excluded from the score rather than guessed, and that is noted. Still produces the scorecard for the messaging items, a prioritized opportunity list, and a start-here section, plus the audit.json + report.md handoff.

assertions.text: Writes an audit.json under .webanatomy/audit-page/ that parses as valid JSON
If the page could not be rendered, the visual items are marked n/a in scorecard.json, score.coverage is below 1, and the audit notes the visual items were not evaluated rather than guessing them
Findings are organized section-first, not dimension-first
Recommendations contain at most three items at severity HIGH
section values use the taxonomy section types (e.g. hero, value-proposition, social-proof, pricing, faq), not freeform labels
Output contains no paste-ready copy or headline rewrites (diagnosis only)
Output ends by offering the two grounded next steps (find-examples for the market view and write-page for the section rework) and names the start-here section

evals.name: pricing-page-url
evals.prompt: what's wrong with this pricing page? feels like people bounce instead of picking a plan. https://www.example-saas.com/pricing — give me a prioritized list of what to fix, no copy please.
evals.expected_output: A pricing-page audit: scorecard on top, then prioritized opportunities focused on plan clarity, a recommended plan, objection handling, and the path to checkout. Urgency is treated as evaluable on a pricing page (not skipped). A start-here section, page-level note, and the audit.json + report.md handoff.

assertions.text: Writes an audit.json under .webanatomy/audit-page/ that parses as valid JSON
audit.json has a score.overall between 0 and 100 and score.categoryScores covering all six categories
Recommendations contain at most three items at severity HIGH
At least one recommendation addresses a pricing-page concern (plan clarity, recommended plan, objection handling, or path to checkout)
Output exposes no internal rubric item IDs and no raw weights or thresholds
Output contains no paste-ready copy or headline rewrites (diagnosis only)
Output ends by offering the two grounded next steps (find-examples for the market view and write-page for the section rework) and names the start-here section
